ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low high-intensity to low-intensity ratio; surface is approximately 97% low-intensity (black/dark grey) with 3% high-intensity (white/light grey) localized anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black field; high-intensity geometric clusters are restricted to the far lateral distal tips (barnacle colonies) and scattered focal points (circular scars) and line segments (abrasions) across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a pixel-measured obtuse angle; depth is shallow relative to the vertical axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous linear boundary with low-amplitude, low-frequency serrations; increased pixel-level irregularity and jaggedness observed at the distal 15% of the trailing edge on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge, tapering to sharp, outward-directed points at the distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several discrete high-contrast circular rings (approx. 6-8) on the mid-left lobe and central region; high-density, textured, multi-tonal clusters (white, tan, dark) fixed to the terminal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal high-intensity linear disruptions; most prominent is a set of parallel horizontal scratches located in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both lateral tips, appearing as protruding, high-contrast, irregular geometric masses.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct triangular cluster of three small circular scars located on the upper quadrant of the left lobe.
